mapper.select: SELECT FPA.PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID SUB_PORTFOLIO_ID, PP.PROFIT_TYPE, PPD.DIS_PERCENT FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PP.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = FPA.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_DIS PPD ON PP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PPD.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE FPA.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT FINPROD_ID finprodId,0 branchId FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT STRATEGY_DET_ID strategyDetId, BATCH_ID batchId, TYPE_2 type2, TYPE_3 type3, TYPE_4 type4, TYPE_5 type5 FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId}

WITH TEMP AS (SELECT STRATEGY_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, MAX(EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY WHERE EFF_DATE <=#{date,jdbcType=DATE} AND PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, STRATEGY_ID ) SELECT PISD.BATCH_ID batchId, PISD.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, PISD.RATIO ratio, TEMP.EFF_DATE effDate FROM TEMP INNER JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY PIS ON PIS.STRATEGY_ID = TEMP.STRATEGY_ID INNER JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL PISD ON PISD.STRATEGY_ID = PIS.STRATEGY_ID
